features.name: Expert Abjurer
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you only need to spend half as much time and gold as normal to copy an abjuration spell into your spellbook.

features.name: Arcane Aegis
features.description: Beginning at 2nd level, when you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level+, you create an Arcane Aegis that absorbs damage directed at you. HP max = 2 × wizard level + INT modifier. Casting another abjuration spell of 1st+ restores aegis HP equal to spell level × 2. Lasts until your next long rest.

features.name: Aegis Extension
features.description: At 6th level, you can use your reaction to have the Arcane Aegis absorb damage dealt to a creature up to 30 feet from you that you can see.

payload.name: Aegis Extension
payload.description: Redirect damage from an ally within 30 ft to your Arcane Aegis.

features.name: Abjuration Proficiency
features.description: Starting at 10th level, add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks made as part of casting an abjuration spell (such as *counterspell* and *dispel magic*).

features.name: Resistance to Magic
features.description: Beginning at 14th level, you have resistance to all damage from spells and advantage on any saving throw to resist a spell's effects.
